title: In-tolerance NAV publishes by policy; outlier price held for human approval
preconditions: Pool P1 with tolerance 2% NAV change and 3% per-price deviation; 250 business days of history.
stimulus: Day 1: all inputs in tolerance. Day 2: one price deviates 7%. An AI agent proposes accepting the price.
expected_states: Day 1: Calculated -> Published (policy), sampled next day. Day 2: Calculated -> ExceptionHold; AI approval rejected; human B approves fallback price -> Approved -> Published.
financial_invariants: Units outstanding unchanged by publication; pool total = sum of DAF unit positions x unit price within RoundingTolerance.
audit_records: PolicyPublication fact with rule version; SampleSelected with seed; ExceptionHold reason; human approval with approver != preparer.
recovery_behavior: If the next-day sample finds an error, NAV corrected via UNB-NAV-038 and sample rate raised.

title: Rule-generated journals post without per-journal approval; manual journal needs second approver; exception-driven close
preconditions: Posting rule v7 approved by two controllers; 10,000 synthetic funds.
stimulus: Month-end: 12,000 fee journals post; accountant A prepares one manual reclass and tries to approve it; controller requests certification.
expected_states: Fee journals posted with rule v7, no approval tasks; A's approval rejected, B approves; certification granted after sample attested.
financial_invariants: Every journal balances per entity x currency x fund x restriction; trial balance unchanged by certification.
audit_records: Rule approval facts (2 approvers), manual journal approval, certification evidence package.
recovery_behavior: If an invariant fails, certification is blocked listing the failing check.

title: Grant funded from buffer straight through; shortfall grant planned; sponsor swaps source without consent
preconditions: Pool buffer $40,000; fund F holds pool units only.
stimulus: Grant G1 $5,000; grant G2 $60,000 (exceeds buffer); sponsor changes G1 funding source to sponsor cash sweep.
expected_states: G1 Funded with no plan or review; G2 FundingPlanned -> LiquidationPending -> Funded; G1 change notified to advisor, no consent request.
financial_invariants: Reserved + paid <= capacity at every step; buffer use reconciled to unit redemption (TVR-FIN-003).
audit_records: Reservation facts, funding plan, advisor notice.
recovery_behavior: If G2 redemption fails, FundingShortfall and sponsor notified.

title: DAF-only books export to sponsor ERP; budgets imported non-posting; derived cash-basis report
preconditions: Sponsor ERP holds operating AP and budgets.
stimulus: Period close; budget import; request for cash-basis report; user attempts to enter a vendor invoice.
expected_states: Summarized balanced journal export produced; budget comparison labelled non-posting; cash-basis report with reconciling items; vendor invoice command unavailable.
financial_invariants: Export totals equal Unbound control-account movements; no journal created by import or report.
audit_records: Export manifest with hashes; import record; report provenance.
recovery_behavior: Failed export retried idempotently by period key.

title: Zero-touch routine grant with reused evidence and automatic 180-day renewal
preconditions: Charity C (170(b)(1)(A), EIN known) verified 170 days ago; OD-01 validated; FreshnessPolicy deep-review 180 days, status window 24h (RCD-006).
stimulus: Renewal job runs on day 170; on day 175 donor D recommends $2,500 to C.
expected_states: Verification Verified -> Verified (renewed, approver=policy vN);Grant Recommended -> Approved (Tier 1) -> Funded -> Released -> Settled
financial_invariants: Reservation <= available capacity;Payment amount = approved amount;No payment before settlement-backed state
audit_records: RenewalCompleted(policy vN, sources, retrieval times);RelianceSnapshot per sponsor;ApprovalRecorded(approverType=deterministicPolicy)
recovery_behavior: If renewal source unavailable, retry; case opened before expiry; grant still evaluated at release.
mock_data_notes: Use a Schedule I row from daf-landscape:data/charity-vetting-ai/resolution-eval-sample.csv as C.

title: Evidence reuse across 40 grants and two sponsors; supporting org hold deduplicated
preconditions: Charity C verified in common registry; sponsors S1, S2; supporting organization O (Type I) with no certification.
stimulus: 40 recommendations to C across S1 and S2; 3 recommendations to O from one fund.
expected_states: C: 40 grants cleared, 1 common verification reused;O: 3 grants Held, 1 case per (fund, O)
financial_invariants: Held grants keep reservations; no payment
audit_records: Each grant cites the same verification id;Case links 3 grants
recovery_behavior: Advisor supplies certification inline -> case closes -> grants re-evaluated automatically.
mock_data_notes: Synthetic sponsors S1/S2 in separate partitions.

title: Material vs informational monitoring events
preconditions: Charity C1 has 2 open grants and 1 dispatched-unsettled ACH; charity C2 has open grant.
stimulus: Auto-revocation file lists C1; 990 shows new board chair for C2.
expected_states: C1: hold published; grants Held; ACH recall requested (externally uncertain); 1 case;C2: evidence updated; no hold; no case
financial_invariants: Recalled payment not marked complete until reconciled;Held grants not released
audit_records: MaterialityClassification(table vN);HoldPublished;RecallRequested outcome
recovery_behavior: Retroactive reinstatement -> held grants re-evaluated per UNB-XIN-NPG-005.

title: Sanctioned after valid deep review (XSIM-09 analogue)
preconditions: Charity C verified 30 days ago; grant approved, unreleased.
stimulus: OFAC list update adds C's legal name and address.
expected_states: Potential match -> release held;Human confirms true match -> Blocked property handling
financial_invariants: No movement of blocked property
audit_records: ScreeningResult;BlockedPropertyRecord
recovery_behavior: False positive -> disposition recorded and release proceeds.

title: Sanctions false-positive disposition reuse and invalidation
preconditions: Charity C dispositioned false positive vs entry E v3.

expected_states: Approval and release proceed with reuse logged;After v4: release held pending adjudication
financial_invariants: No release while potential match unresolved
audit_records: DispositionReused(original id);ReuseInvalidated(reason=entry changed)
recovery_behavior: Reviewer re-adjudicates; new disposition keyed to v4.

title: Renewal outage near expiry
preconditions: IRS bulk source unavailable for 12 days; 900 verifications reach lead time.
stimulus: Renewal attempts fail repeatedly.
expected_states: Retries with backoff;Cases opened before expiry (one parent case for source outage);At expiry: new approvals Held for affected charities; release-time checks use status window rule
financial_invariants: No approval on expired deep review
audit_records: SourceOutage evidence;Parent/child cases
recovery_behavior: Source restored -> bulk renewal -> holds lift automatically.

title: Machine-evaluated control passes all quarter; no owner attestation requested
preconditions: Control UNB-SCTRL-025 (balanced journals) classified MachineEvaluated; 40,000 postings in quarter; collector healthy.
stimulus: Quarter end.

financial_invariants: debits = credits for every batch

recovery_behavior: n/a

title: Silent collector during zero-activity period is not read as pass

recovery_behavior: After collector restored and backfill confirms no events, owner closes with independent reviewer (OPS-018).

title: PR touching payment gate without mapped control fails CI
preconditions: Path src/payments/gate/* mapped to UNB-SCTRL-029; new path src/payments/rails/new_rail/* unmapped.
stimulus: PR changes both paths.
expected_states: CI attaches UNB-SCTRL-029 to change record;CI fails: unmapped risk-bearing path
financial_invariants: no deployment
audit_records: ChangeRecord with derived controls;CIFailed(UNMAPPED_RISK_PATH)
recovery_behavior: Developer adds path mapping in register (reviewed change); CI passes.
mock_data_notes: Developer never types control IDs in PR text.

title: Owner departs; reviewer role disjointness enforced
preconditions: Key control reconciliation: owner role Controller (1 holder), reviewer role Outsourced Accountant (1 holder).

expected_states: Assignment denied (holder overlap);Deficiency raised: owner role unresolved;Backup role holder becomes acting owner
financial_invariants: reconciliation continues to run

recovery_behavior: New controller assigned; deficiency closed by reviewer.
mock_data_notes: Non-key control (e.g. notification privacy) has no reviewer role and raises no deficiency.

title: AI-drafted case summary needs no sign-off; AI-supported eligibility exception goes through A4 approval only
preconditions: Agent drafts evidence summary for a grant to a charity with a revoked-status discrepancy.
stimulus: Summary drafted; grant routed as eligibility exception (A4).
expected_states: Summary stored with model/prompt/policy versions, no sign-off task;A4 approval by non-originating human records the summary as evidence viewed
financial_invariants: no payment release before A4 approval
audit_records: AIRun;ApprovalGranted(actorType=Human, evidenceSnapshot includes AIRun)
recovery_behavior: If decision class lookup fails, item treated as A4.
mock_data_notes: Agent attempt to call approve command is denied (tool removed by broker).

title: Prompt edit deploys on passing suites; permission expansion waits for approval
preconditions: Service agent prompt v12 -> v13 wording change; separately, manifest change adds tool ReadBankDetails.

expected_states: v13 deploys after suites pass, no human task;Manifest change blocked pending AI governance approval
financial_invariants: n/a
audit_records: EvalSuitePassed(v13);PermissionExpansionDetected;ApprovalRequired
recovery_behavior: Regression beyond tolerance on v13 variant blocks deployment.
mock_data_notes: Seeded injection case in adversarial suite.

title: Single operator pauses payments; two people needed to resume
preconditions: Suspected bank-file compromise at 02:00; one on-call operator.
stimulus: Operator activates enterprise payments pause.
expected_states: Pause effective immediately;Security owner and second role notified;Resume by operator alone denied; resume with second approver succeeds
financial_invariants: no payment dispatched during pause;accepted grants retain reservations
audit_records: KillSwitchActivated(actor=1);KillSwitchReleaseDenied(SINGLE_ACTOR);KillSwitchReleased(actors=2)
recovery_behavior: Queued dispatches resume with release-time re-check (TVCTL-04).
mock_data_notes: Agent principal attempting release is denied.

title: Historical (RR-UNB-GOV-002-r1 only): tightening threshold used one approver; loosening needed independent approval

financial_invariants: no grant evaluated under unpublished version
audit_records: PolicyBackTested;PolicyPublished(classification)
recovery_behavior: Unclassifiable change treated as loosening.
mock_data_notes: Retired 2026-11-26: tests the superseded RR-UNB-GOV-002-r1 only; current behaviour is SPS-REV-011 (RR-UNB-GOV-002-r2). Back-test corpus of synthetic historical grants.

title: Presentation-only requirement with one scenario passes coverage; risk-bearing with two fails

stimulus: CI coverage run.
expected_states: INT-019 satisfied;UNB-RCN-PLT-003 reported missing adversarial scenario; release gate blocks
financial_invariants: n/a

recovery_behavior: Add adversarial scenario.

title: Existing donor opens a second fund with prefilled intake

financial_invariants: No capacity on F-2 until contributions are final.
audit_records: Prefill sources with fact IDs/versions; confirming principal; agreement version/timestamp.
recovery_behavior: If identity source Unknown, field empty and proofing runs.

title: Routine and non-standard fund acceptance
preconditions: Sponsor S-1 without recorded delegation; S-2 with recorded delegation. Fund A standard; fund B names a trust as holder.

financial_invariants: Capacity zero until first contribution final.
audit_records: Rule version, delegation reference or batch approver, inputs.
recovery_behavior: Rule engine outage leaves funds Drafted and creates WorkItems.

title: Statement publication with default quarterly digest and correction
preconditions: Fund F-3 donor with default preference; fund F-4 donor without e-consent.

financial_invariants: Statement balances equal certified snapshot.
audit_records: Snapshot IDs, both Feb versions, notification and mail records.
recovery_behavior: Uncertified close: last statement shown with period label.

title: Reconsideration filed on day 75
preconditions: Grant declined with reason PURPOSE_NOT_PERMITTED_BY_POLICY; window per SPD-ENT-002.
stimulus: Donor requests reconsideration 75 days after notice.

financial_invariants: No reservation change.

title: Affiliation confirmation embedded in session

financial_invariants: Recommendation still routed to TVCTL-14 review if recipient matches an affiliation.
audit_records: Confirmation timestamp and version.
recovery_behavior: If A-1 edits affiliations, screening re-runs on pending recommendations.

title: Human-intervention classes and AI-involvement prohibition
preconditions: Sponsor S1 with rules R-SAN-PM (sanctions potential match, class IndependentControl), R-DOC-MISS (missing donor document, class AvoidableAdministrative, threshold 25/month) and a draft rule R-AI-LOW (create item when AI confidence < 0.8).
stimulus: Publish R-AI-LOW; then run January and February with 40 R-DOC-MISS items each.
expected_states: R-AI-LOW publication rejected HIC_AI_INVOLVEMENT_NOT_A_CLASS; redrafted as AmbiguousEvidence citing contradictory registry claims, published. After February close, InterventionProposal IP-1 opened for R-DOC-MISS owner.
financial_invariants: No grant changes state because of classification; held outcomes remain held.
audit_records: Rule publication attempt, rejection code, item class per item, proposal creation.
recovery_behavior: Proposal can be rejected with reason; class taxonomy version pinned per item.
mock_data_notes: Synthetic rules and 80 items; no real donors.

title: Holiday authority coverage with per-item SoD
preconditions: 5 treasury-authorized holders T1–T5, cross-trained; coverage depth = double absence. Leave: T1,T2 Dec 24–Jan 2; T3 Dec 29.
stimulus: Coverage run on Dec 10; NotReceived item N-7 created Dec 29 for an attempt released by T4.
expected_states: Dec 24–28, 30–Jan 2: covered (3 available). Dec 29: T4,T5 available but T4 is releaser of N-7 → only 1 eligible approver → CoverageGap opened Dec 10 for Dec 29. If unresolved, N-7 waits and escalates at SLA; never decided by one person.
financial_invariants: No payment resolved by fewer than two independent approvers; no double payment.
audit_records: Coverage records per day, gap item, escalation, N-7 decision approvers.
recovery_behavior: Pre-authorized backup delegate B1 activated by board resolution closes gap.

title: No eligible assignee: sticky owner absent, backup conflicted
preconditions: AssignmentPolicy for exception grants: StickyRelationship → SkillBased(foreign grants) → Escalation(ORG-R02). Owner O1 on leave; backup O2 has recorded related-party link to payee.

audit_records: AssignmentDecision with eligible-set digest and exclusions; escalation event.
recovery_behavior: When O1 returns, relationship ownership unchanged; G-11 stays with R3 to completion (cradle-to-grave for the case).

title: Specialist handoff returns to cradle-to-grave owner

audit_records: Ownership history, handoff events, approver eligibility check.

audit_records: Source observation id, rule version, propagation records per sponsor partition.
